# arin Provider

Manage ARIN RPKI objects (ROAs, ASPAs) and IRR objects (route, aut-num, as-set,
route-set) through ARIN's RESTful APIs.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `org_handle` (String) Org handle owning the RPKI objects. Use provider aliases
  for multiple orgs.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) ARIN API key. Falls back to the ARIN_API_KEY
  environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) API base URL. Defaults to https://reg.arin.net. Set to
  https://reg.ote.arin.net for OT&E.
